pricing.billingNote: 100% free podcast feeds and web streaming; optional listener donations.
pricing.freeTierNote: Full access to ~4,800 curated episodes across Horror, Sci-Fi, Thrillers, Strange Tales, and Case Closed.

provenance.primaryMasterSource: Hand-selected, loudness-normalized transfers from OTRR and collector archives
provenance.airdateMethodology: Host cites original broadcast date and episode number in podcast show notes and spoken outro
provenance.castAttributionMethod: Basic series notes; no structured actor-to-character database
provenance.captionEngine: None (Apple Podcasts auto-transcripts only on iOS client)

specNotes.podcast_rss: Curated weekly genre podcast feeds (~3,200 total episodes across 5 feeds), not a complete series archive.

primary_source_verification.summary: Show notes accurately state original broadcast date and series episode number for curated selections.
primary_source_verification.evidenceQuote: "Each podcast post cites the original series, broadcast date, and episode title."

cast_credit_accuracy.summary: Mentions headline stars occasionally in blog posts, without structured cast/character metadata.
cast_credit_accuracy.evidenceQuote: "WordPress show notes focus on series history and air date rather than full cast rosters."

vtt_transcripts.evidenceQuote: "Audio MP3 enclosures only; no WebVTT files served."

master_provenance.summary: Host screens out unlistenable low-bitrate mud and normalizes levels at 96–128 kbps MP3, though original disc matrix numbers aren't tracked.
master_provenance.evidenceQuote: "Curated for listenable audio quality and consistent volume across episodes."

serial_continuity.summary: Thematic anthology feeds (*The Horror*, *Sci-Fi*, *Case Closed*) jump across different series each week rather than presenting contiguous serial arcs.
serial_continuity.evidenceQuote: "Anthology podcast format rotates between different series every episode."

open_api_export.summary: Standard XML Podcast RSS feeds and WordPress REST API posts, though organized by podcast feed rather than canonical OTR series.
open_api_export.evidenceQuote: "Provides standard RSS 2.0 podcast feeds with direct MP3 enclosures."

ad_free_playback.summary: Listener-supported with zero third-party commercial ad injections.
ad_free_playback.evidenceQuote: "100% listener-supported with no dynamic ad insertion interrupting the broadcasts."

dedup_integrity.summary: Careful host curation avoids duplicate uploads within a feed, though some classic episodes appear in both a genre feed and a special feed.
dedup_integrity.evidenceQuote: "Curated release log tracks every episode aired on each thematic feed since 2006."

gotchas.title: Thematic Anthology Format Breaks Complete Series Browsing
gotchas.detail: Organized around 6 genre podcast feeds rather than complete chronological runs of 1,400+ series.

gotchas.title: Covers ~4,850 Episodes (~4% of Known Surviving Broadcasts)
gotchas.detail: Excludes daytime serials, variety/music programs, news broadcasts, and deep-catalog drama runs.
